roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Examine raw data to draw conclusions about information using automated tools and statistical methods.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Develop and implement algorithms, predictive models, and custom statistical analyses for complex data sets.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Design and build production-grade machine learning pipelines, model deployment, and optimization systems.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Study organization operations, business procedures, and workflows to design improved data-driven solutions.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.description: Plan, implement, and upgrade security measures for the protection of computer networks and information.
